findings.summary: The working tree contains a large v1.1 phase-planning addition that is not part of task 9.1.
findings.detail: `git diff` shows ~1388 lines added to PLANS.md ('v1.1 Milestones (Phases 9-14)', DG-10..DG-14 rows, milestone table rows 9-14) plus untracked `docs/implementation/planning/v1.1-phases.json`. These are the implementation-planner's output (its `change` field describes deriving v1.1 into phases 9-14 in PLANS.md), produced before task 9.1, and are consistent with the accepted scope. They are not task 9.1 code and do not affect its correctness. Recorded so the orchestrator knows the uncommitted tree mixes the planning deliverable with the 9.1 deliverable.
findings.recommended_action: None for 9.1. The orchestrator should decide whether the planning artifact is committed separately from the 9.1 change.

findings.summary: The host-guarded PluginsController fact is skipped in this environment; its controller-level claim was verified against the pinned source instead.
findings.detail: `ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR` is unset and no `Jellyfin.Api.dll` exists in the environment, so `PinnedPluginsControllerPostDeserializesWithThePinnedOptions` reports [SKIP]. The skip is honest: running the fact with `ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR=/tmp/9.1/nohost` produced a FAIL ('Expected the pinned host Jellyfin.Api.dll at ...'), not a pass or skip. The underlying claim (`_serializerOptions = JsonDefaults.Options` in the PluginsController constructor and the POST route) was independently confirmed by fetching the pinned v12.0 source.
findings.recommended_action: None. Optionally execute the host-guarded fact when a pinned host directory is available.

findings.summary: The host-guarded test registers a process-global AssemblyLoadContext resolving handler that is never removed.
findings.detail: `ConfigurationRoundTripTests.HostAssembly` adds a handler to `AssemblyLoadContext.Default.Resolving` inside a Lazy and never unregisters it. This only executes when the host directory is set, and the handler is a bounded fallback that loads only from the host directory, so it does not affect the default suite. It could theoretically interact with other host-guarded tests in the same process, but no failure was observed and this is not a 9.1 correctness issue.

verified_claims: The pinned PluginsController POST deserializes with JsonDefaults.Options, and JsonDefaults.Options has a null PropertyNamingPolicy (PascalCase) with default Replace object-creation handling. Verified against the pinned v12.0 source and by an independent scratch probe.
A get-only Collection<T> property is NOT populated under JsonDefaults.Options and is silently dropped. Independently reproduced (get-only -> 0 items; settable -> 2 items).

Both persisted collections are now settable with a backing field and a null-coalescing setter; the non-null invariant used by PluginConfigurationValidator.Validate and PluginConfigurationSnapshot.From is preserved (JSON null -> empty non-null collection).

The persisted XML shape is unchanged and backward compatible. Independently serialized the real PluginConfiguration: <EnabledLibraries><string>..</string></EnabledLibraries> and <Renderer><Selectors><BadgeSelectorConfiguration>..; reload preserves values.

CA2227 is suppressed per property with a justification, scoped by #pragma disable/restore; a clean rebuild reports 0 warnings / 0 errors. The suppression pattern is consistent with existing CA5359/CA1711/CA1849 suppressions.

Test counts: filtered round-trip suite 6 passed / 1 skipped / 7 total; full default suite 1234 passed / 61 skipped / 1295 total. Both reproduced. The baseline 1228/60/1288 is documented in docs/changelog.md (task 8.6).
The host-guarded skip is honest: it fails (not skips/passes) when ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is set to a directory without Jellyfin.Api.dll.
Tasks 9.2-9.4 remain unimplemented: no IHasWebPages/GetPages/PluginPageInfo, no config.html, no Plugin.UpdateConfiguration override in src/.
Documentation accurately reflects the shipped change with no overclaim (data-model 3.12, changelog, project-status, implementation-readiness, PLANS task/milestone/status).
